records.name: Brandmeisterin Löschschluss
records.biography_en: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest. She divides HyperNorm emergencies into contained and awaiting containment. Her speaking trumpet struggles when a dissonant card describes something worth saving on both sides of the line. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Einsatz ist geordnet. Die Erschöpfung bleibt vor Ort.

variant_notes.note_en: Can organize an emergency faster than she can admit she needs a rest.

records.name: Schlauchwart Knickfrei
records.biography_en: Trusts water completely and hoses only provisionally. He coils the HyperNorm hose according to a diagram that contains no bends. A dissonant card asks whether the water has seen the diagram. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Schlauch gilt als knickfrei, sofern unbewegt.

variant_notes.note_en: Trusts water completely and hoses only provisionally.

records.name: Axtträger Offenjetzt
records.biography_en: Regards every locked door as a discussion that has gone on too long. His axe opens HyperNorm doors labelled permanently closed. A dissonant card points out that an open doorway can still be a boundary. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Türöffnung ersetzt vorläufig die Aussprache.

variant_notes.note_en: Regards every locked door as a discussion that has gone on too long.

records.name: Maschinist Drucksache
records.biography_en: Can hold the pressure steady while everything else becomes approximate. His dial divides HyperNorm pressure into correct and regrettable. A dissonant card sits precisely between the marks and refuses to explode. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Druck ist im Rahmen. Der Rahmen ächzt.

variant_notes.note_en: Can hold the pressure steady while everything else becomes approximate.

records.name: Rettungsmann Ganzruhig
records.biography_en: Lends his calm to anyone who has temporarily misplaced theirs. He sorts HyperNorm rescues into safely returned and not safely returned yet. A dissonant card asks why rescue should require the correct address. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Ruhe wird leihweise zur Verfügung gestellt.

variant_notes.note_en: Lends his calm to anyone who has temporarily misplaced theirs.

records.name: Funkerin Nachalarm
records.biography_en: Hears the next emergency in the silence after the last one. Her radio announces every HyperNorm incident as either resolved or somebody else's department. She hears the frightened breathing between those categories. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der nächste Alarm ist vorsorglich bereits mitgehört.

variant_notes.note_en: Hears the next emergency in the silence after the last one.
